businessModel: Free browser funding Perplexity subscriptions (Pro ~$20/mo, Max ~$200/mo) and Comet Plus
paidNote: Perplexity Pro/Max raise AI limits; some features (e.g. Computer) are Max-only
summary: Chromium browser with Perplexity's assistant and a task-running agent. Launched Jul 2025 on desktop (paid-only), free since Oct 2025, with Android (Nov 2025) and iOS (Mar 2026) apps.
bestFor: Perplexity users who want research and agents in the browser
People who want an AI browser on desktop and mobile
notFor: Users wanting local or offline AI

pros.title: Free on all platforms
pros.detail: Paywall dropped Oct 2025; desktop and mobile apps are free to download.

pros.title: Strong research assistant
pros.detail: Perplexity answers and agent actions available in a sidebar on any page.

pros.title: Chrome extension compatibility
pros.detail: Installs from the Chrome Web Store via "Add to Comet" (MV3).

pros.title: Enterprise option
pros.detail: Comet for Enterprise can be deployed through MDM.

cons.title: Prompt-injection concerns
cons.detail: CometJacking and other disclosed attacks showed agent data-exfiltration risks.

cons.title: Cloud-only AI
cons.detail: Page content and prompts go to Perplexity servers; no local model option.

cons.title: No Linux build
cons.detail: Only Windows, macOS, Android and iOS.

cons.title: Best features paywalled
cons.detail: Higher usage limits and the Computer feature need Pro/Max subscriptions.

faq.a: Yes, the browser has been free since Oct 2, 2025; paid Perplexity plans only raise AI limits and unlock extras.
Windows 10+, macOS, Android 12+ and iOS 18+; no Linux build.
Yes via the Chrome Web Store, but only MV3; full uBlock Origin is unavailable.

timeline.event: Comet launches on Windows/macOS for Perplexity Max subscribers

jsSpeed: Blink/V8 engine, Chrome-class JS speed; no vendor benchmark
pageLoad: Chromium rendering; AI sidebar adds overhead
networkSpeed: Chromium network stack with HTTP/3 and preloading
startup: Chromium cold start, heavier than plain Chrome
memory: Chromium multi-process plus AI layer; RAM-heavy
cpu: Chromium-class; agent tasks add background load
lowEnd: Needs modern hardware; AI features add load
installSize: Full Chromium bundle, a few hundred MB
privacyDefaults: AI features send page context to cloud; little blocking by default
blocking: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite are available
patchSpeed: Follows Chromium stable; lag not independently measured
telemetry: Vendor telemetry; prompts processed in cloud
behaviourCustom: Few shortcut or per-site options documented
tabManagement: Tab groups and search; no workspaces documented
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus
productivity: Sidebar assistant, page summaries, agent tasks
translation: AI-driven page translation; no dedicated engine
extras: AI agent and memory; no VPN or wallet
extensions: Chrome Web Store via Add to Comet; MV3 only
mobileApps: Android and iOS apps; iOS limited to WebKit
accessibility: Chromium accessibility stack, unverified for AI layer
businessTrust: Prompt-injection incidents; cloud processing of page data
ai: Full assistant plus agent on desktop and mobile
beginnerFriendly: Chrome-like UI, free, assistant easy to start

featureNotes.adBlocker: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite
featureNotes.mv2Support: MV2 removed upstream; Chrome Web Store dropped MV2 Aug 31, 2026
featureNotes.agenticBrowsing: Comet Assistant agent; Computer for Max
featureNotes.aiKillSwitch: Assistant is core; no documented single off switch
